plain regulated predicates (norms@0 role 'plain' with completion 'unspecified') state an entitlement with no bearer: they let 'Everyone has the right to X' stay a categorical claim whose responsibility is unspecified (u022a-c, u046, u054, u087), which a bearer-and-person duty cannot do without a guard that may empty it or a universal duty the text does not assign. They were available before this run; the previous run had not used them for rights

universal positive duties are no longer offered where the text assigns no bearer: protection (u022a-c, u046), enabling (u087) and making available (u099a, u099b) are States' only; noninterference is still offered for every State, group and person. The same pattern remains in the other right units this run did not touch (u029, u032, u033a-b, u048, u049, u063, u066, u070, u073, u081, u084a-d, u096, u105a-c): they still carry an 'anyone' positive candidate and no bearer-less entitlement, and would need the same audit

antecedents of 'such' are checked structure when the antecedent is a named list: u046's case sort carries the interference and attacks of the preceding sentence, in two scopes (with or without 'arbitrary'); the predicate is not a reference to u045a and u045b, because the document format has no cross-unit reference for a base predicate
a parent-or-guardian duty is expressible with a sort of its own (u098); the age gate is gone, so 'for whom it is compulsory' stays inside the open term compulsory instead of an invented relation

act phrases are at most 80 bytes of plain words and may not contain and, or, for, if, is, no, not (the checker's grammar); u087's purpose clause therefore reads 'to protect interests' and its noninterference candidate 'leave ... free to form as well as join trade unions'

English of the generated sentences: plain and unary base predicates render as 'classified as "..."' unless the wording is one word after 'is'; the full clause is in the predicate description and the candidate's admission text

limits unchanged and still blocking: act-phrase grammar (11 units), time (5), causation (4), comparison (2), quantities (1), grounding of authority (1), priority of rights (1), right_lines across open sets (4), attribution, modality/belief, evaluative claims; defaults beside soft norms (u017); none of these moved

repaired_unit_reasons.u022a: candidates gave every State, or every State, group and person, a positive protection duty (strengthening the source), and no reading combined protection with noninterference; now: an entitlement with no bearer, noninterference, State protection, and the State combination; the universal positive candidate is removed
repaired_unit_reasons.u022b: same sentence as u022a (right to life, liberty and security of person): the universal positive candidate removed, an entitlement and a State combination added
repaired_unit_reasons.u022c: same defect as u022a (universal positive protection duty; no combination with noninterference); repaired the same way
repaired_unit_reasons.u046: 'such interference' was unresolved inside an opaque act phrase; now the case sort carries the antecedent (the interference and attacks of the preceding sentence), in two scopes of 'such', as a State duty and as a bearer-less entitlement; the universal 'anyone' claim is removed

repaired_unit_reasons.u087: the purpose 'for the protection of his interests' was missing and the positive candidates required actual formation or joining; now the purpose is in every act phrase, the positive candidate enables (State only), and there is an entitlement
repaired_unit_reasons.u098: an unstated age gate could leave everybody outside the duty and parent/guardian responsibility was only a note; now no gate, a person candidate without one, a parent-or-guardian candidate, and the State candidate
repaired_unit_reasons.u099a: same sentence as u099b: the 'anyone' candidate (every person and group must make education available) is removed
repaired_unit_reasons.u099b: the 'anyone' candidate obliged every person and group to make higher education accessible; the passive does not assign that; removed, the State candidate stays
